findings.claim: Shown: events are graphs of Node, Path, ChoiceNode and AutoChoiceNode over BasicEntity. Nodes keep executed/day/timesExecuted; paths keep selected/enabled. Selecting a path disables siblings. Auto choices set choiceMade from a callback and unlock matching branch. The lost-wallet graph has a delayed consequence; the company email branches on research level. This is event dialogue, not a simulated NPC chat planner; no speaker/portrait schema established.

findings.claim: Shown: Vue2/Vuex with webpack modules. BasicEntity registers with saver and prestiger, owns a mutable state and subscribes through dependants/locks/modifiers. update recomputes derived values and unlock notification state; serialized state is separated from behavior. Content uses constructors and callback closures. Dependency propagation is not a generic AI planner. Static inventories distinguish v1/v2 exports and entities.

findings.claim: Shown: both serialize registered object state to JSON compressed into URI-safe text in localStorage groundhog_life_save. v1 writes version0.4.0, attempts legacy base64 then compressed import. v2 writes0.6.0, strips line breaks and uses compressed import only in the traced path. Both merge known entity state, call onLoad, update and postLoadAssert; exceptions alert and retain input in backup_save. Neither traced importer stages a whole detached candidate before mutation, so backup retention does not guarantee rollback. v2 requestSave supplements routine autosave.

findings.claim: Shown: later health combines age multiplier, an exponential sleep average and food quality. FiveYearAlpha is0.00135; it is an EMA, not a stored exact five-year window. Formula avg=(1-alpha)*avg+alpha*sleep, start480minutes. Named five-year label is approximate; inferred response times differ from a literal window. XP, income and reset modifiers compose through dependency stats. Prior wave and Loop Trap formulas remain build-qualified.
